Application Data.NAME: John's Appliance Emporium
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: John's Appliance Emporium specializes in the retail sales and repair of household appliances. We focus primarily on on-site sales, ensuring a secure and well-maintained inventory storage area. Our operations include limited delivery and emergency repair services, which account for less than 25% of total revenue. We pride ourselves on compliance with manufacturer installation protocols and industry safety standards, with a history of minimal claims related to property damage and installation errors. Our physical storefront is equipped with a centrally monitored alarm system and recent electrical system upgrades, enhancing our security and reducing fire and theft risks. Our annual sales are under $500,000, with strict inventory control measures and loss prevention protocols in place.

Both incidents are considered resolved with no ongoing claims.
